stage: graph-tool qualification only; no production PCB, manifest, routing, plane, zone, or fill modified

implemented.primitive_graph: Enumerates enabled copper layers in CopperLayerToOrdinal physical order and joins all declared plated pad/via layers while retaining public APIs.
implemented.filled_zone_graph: Inspects the complete declared layer set and fails unless every declared layer is enabled copper before physical-order sorting; no unsupported layer is silently filtered.

repaired_fixture.fill_timing: Fill completed before the 45-second process deadline, but exact timing was not emitted because a later assertion stopped the control before report serialization.

current_blocker.failure: Post-fill primitive control reported the different-net In1 crossing as connected.
current_blocker.assertion: Different-net inner crossing was silently connected
current_blocker.disposition: The repaired run is not accepted as all-layer qualification. No retry was made because only one native-fill attempt was authorized. Filled-zone positive/negative connectivity assertions were not reached.

prior_failed_fixture_history.failure: The first fixture lacked Edge.Cuts and used an already-connected positive GND witness; it timed out after a kimath overflow assertion.
prior_failed_fixture_history.interpretation: That result was a fixture failure and is not evidence that real four-layer filling fails.

post_run_safety_guard.change: The control now refuses to reuse the prior pad-group fingerprint unless both production PCB hashes and the primitive-graph source hash match the measured inputs.
post_run_safety_guard.validation: Syntax checked only after this guard was added; no further native fill or graph-control run.
